Not all stories are written in fairytales — some are written on the world’s greatest pitches. If Lionel Messi’s legendary journey inspires your sense of adventure, these Storybook Itinerary ideas invite you to follow in the footsteps of a global icon across stadiums, cities, and destinations where the beautiful game comes to life.

Ready to begin your soccer-inspired story? Click HERE and let us create your Messi-inspired itinerary.

Canada • Mexico • USA

Step into one of the greatest sporting stories ever told — the FIFA World Cup 2026.
Held from 11 June to 19 July 2026, this tournament spans stadiums across Canada, Mexico, and the United States, creating the perfect opportunity to immerse yourself in the global celebration of football. Feel the roar of the crowds, the electrifying energy, and the unforgettable atmosphere that only the World Cup can bring.

Click HERE and let us help you plan your ultimate World Cup adventure.

Home of Lionel Messi & Inter Miami CF**

Miami is more than sun-soaked glam — it’s Messi’s current home and the heart of his Major League Soccer journey with Inter Miami CF.
Discover a city where football passion meets tropical paradise. Relax on sparkling beaches after days of theme-park thrills in nearby Orlando, explore world-class museums, browse vibrant shopping districts, or venture into the wild beauty of the Everglades National Park. With cruises departing to the Bahamas and Caribbean, Miami is the perfect place to begin or end your adventure.

Click HERE and let us design the Miami chapter of your story.

A Stadium of Legends

The iconic Melbourne Cricket Ground has welcomed countless sporting greats — including Lionel Messi, who played unforgettable matches here in 2007 and 2017.
Hosting cricket, AFL, soccer and more, the MCG is also home to the immersive Australian Sports Museum, where fans can dive into interactive exhibits celebrating legendary athletes and moments.

Click HERE to add the MCG to your itinerary and walk in the footsteps of champions.

A City of Passion, Culture & Football

While Messi grew up in Rosario, the heartbeat of Argentina can be felt deeply in its capital, Buenos Aires.
A vibrant city bursting with culture, colour, and soul, it offers everything from atmospheric markets and lush parks to captivating museums, cooking classes, and tango experiences. For travellers seeking to immerse themselves in the spirit of Argentina — its passion, its pride, its love of the game — Buenos Aires is unforgettable.
